title: TILE: Bridging LLMs and Table Foundation Models for Tabular Learning with Strings
abstract: arXiv:2610.17065v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Real-world tables are often heterogeneous, combining numerical features with free-form string columns. Table foundation models (TFMs) excel on numerical tables but require strings to be encoded numerically, while large language models (LLMs) hold semantic knowledge but are not designed for tabular predictions. Most existing bridges use LLMs as plug-in encoders for cell strings, yet how to extract representations effectively for tabular learning remains underexplored. We show that the interface between LLMs and tables matters as much as the LLM itself. Applied cell-wise, larger LLMs do not give better features. With our interface, the same LLMs improve steadily with size. TILE (Table-Interfaced LLM Embeddings) combines four ingredients: row serialization to provide cross-column context, intermediate-layer extraction to avoid layers specialized for next-token prediction, columnar pooling to remove mean pooling's length bias, and by-pas

translated_title: TILE：以字符串连接大语言模型与表格基础模型实现表格学习
translated_abstract: 现实世界中的表格往往是异构的，同时包含数值特征与自由格式的字符串列。表格基础模型（TFMs）在数值表格上表现出色，但要求字符串必须被数值化编码；而大语言模型（LLMs）虽蕴含丰富的语义知识，却并非为表格预测任务而设计。现有的大多数桥接方法将LLM用作单元格字符串的即插即用编码器，但如何有效提取表征以服务于表格学习仍未被充分探索。我们证明，LLM与表格之间的接口设计与LLM本身同等重要：若按单元格方式逐一应用，更大的LLM并不能带来更好的特征；而借助我们的接口，相同的LLM会随规模增大而持续提升性能。TILE（Table-Interfaced LLM Embeddings，表格接口化LLM嵌入）结合了四个关键要素：行序列化以提供跨列上下文、中间层提取以避免使用专为下一词预测而特化的层、列向池化以消除平均池化的长度偏差，以及（摘要此处被截断）……
tldr: 本文提出TILE方法，通过精心设计LLM与表格之间的接口（行序列化、中间层提取、列向池化等四个要素），有效桥接大语言模型与表格基础模型，证明接口设计与模型规模同等重要，从而使LLM嵌入能更好地服务于含字符串列的表格学习。
en_tdlr: TILE introduces a table-interfaced LLM embedding approach (row serialization, intermediate-layer extraction, and columnar pooling) that bridges LLMs and table foundation models, demonstrating that the table-LLM interface design matters as much as LLM size for tabular learning with string columns.
